results.name: S1 the two new blocks are on the page, once
S1 removing them gives the base page byte for byte (DATA, MASTER_LOC, money, footer, every screen unchanged)
S2 embedded data matches its recorded sha256
S2 page data names the source files it came from (shapes and footprints)
S2 no agent or model names, no author name, no dollar figure in the page data
S3 MasterShapes915 loads, frozen, read only
S3 refs() lists every reference with a shape
S3 every reference on the page (DATA and MASTER_LOC) has a shape or a reason
S3 no reference is without a shape except cancelled ones (kept with a note) and T0265 (4 fridges, no footprint anywhere)
S3 shape() hands out a copy (cannot change the data)
S3b every unit in inventory.json is answered, in order, with its own type, index and number
S3b every active unit has exactly one shape (its own part, never shared), and draws on its own
S3b meta counts the units by source
S3b a unit is found by its loading id and its number (for the Arrange loads door choice)
S4 every traced outline's centroid within 0.5 m of the PDF centroid after the transform
S4 every traced vertex is a PDF corner (under 0.01 pt)
S4 every door swing is the PDF arc: the 117 of 8 Oct point for point, every arc end and leaf under 0.01 m / 0.01 pt
S4 every water-barrier piece is a PDF piece, and every barrier line vertex a piece-end mid point or the meeting of two (under 0.01 pt)
S4b every part not drawn on the master cites its source, uses its reconciled footprint, and says "size to confirm" where it is
S4b footprints: where the catalogues disagree by more than 10% the drawn size is used only with direct drawing evidence, else "size to confirm"
S4c every waste tank (6) is its block's own outline, drawn grey under the block with "+ WASTE TANK" on the map and as its own "WASTE TANK" item for loads
S4d every water-barrier reference is a line shape (white-and-yellow pieces), traced where the master draws it
S5 svg keeps every edge's direction (rotation exact)
S5 svg keeps every edge's length ratio (aspect exact)
S6 scaling is uniform: one factor for every edge of every part
S6 under minPx the shape is scaled up to exactly minPx, otherwise true size (barrier lines never scaled)
S7 the door mark sits on the master's door edge, square to it, pointing out
S8 a chosen edge replaces the master's door; door:'none' draws none
S9 project() (the explorer camera) and pxPerPt + rot draw the same shape
S9 a reference with no position on the master, MASTER_LOC or a record pin is never put on the map (shape for loads only)
S10 the number badge stays readable (radius 11 px at any zoom)
S11 svg(ref, {unit}) draws that unit and nothing else
S12 traced parts are solid, parts not drawn on the master dashed (outlines and barrier lines)
S12 each kind is recognisable: FWF circle, accessible-toilet sign, generator diagonal, barrier white-and-yellow, tags
